title: Remittances Beat Foreign Investment By $270 Billion
hook: Family remittances beat foreign investment by $270 billion.
closing: Workers abroad can move more money than foreign companies, making family transfers economically massive.
question: Did you expect remittances to beat investment?

segments.say: Remittances reached $685 billion in 2024, showing family transfers have become a massive global financial flow.
India received $120 billion in remittances, showing how strongly one country's households can depend on money earned abroad.
In 2023, remittances exceeded foreign investment by $270 billion, overturning the idea that big companies move more money.
